title: Samart's conjecture n_4(81)=40M_7: the exact CM evaluation and the two obstructions. A status report
summary: This note archives the status of Samart's Table-6 conjecture $n_4(81)=40M_7$, $M_7:=L'(g_7,0)$, where $g_7(τ)=η(τ)^3η(7τ)^3$ is the newform of $S_3(Γ_0(7),χ_{-7})$ and $n_4(s):=4m(x^4+y^4+z^4+1+s^{1/4}xyz)$. The conjecture is the cleanest of Samart's open interior-point entries (discriminant $-7$, class number $1$, a single $L$-value), and it was dropped as a theorem target in the companion paper, where the two $n_2$-family conjectures were proved.
